summary.business_type: Financial Web Application / Interactive Calculator Tool
top_findings: 9 Canadian provincial calculators are orphaned (in sitemap.xml with 0 incoming internal links)
55 page titles exceed 60 characters and 50 meta descriptions exceed 160 characters, causing mobile SERP snippet truncation
Severe CTR depression on high-volume state pages (e.g., /us/new-york at Pos 9.1 with 2,133 impressions has only 0.05% CTR)
GSC tracking URL fragment links (/#calculator, /#faq) due to on-page hash anchor navigation
Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) header despite strong HSTS and X-Frame-Options
Exceptional server-rendered content (8,413 words) and compliant llms.txt supporting AI search visibility
quick_wins: Link all 9 Canadian provincial pages from /canada province grid to resolve orphan page status immediately
Rewrite /us/new-york title and meta description to target high-intent NYC 8.875% tax extraction, lifting CTR from 0.05%
Trim state calculator titles to 52-58 chars (e.g. 'Arkansas Reverse Sales Tax Calculator (9.49%)') to prevent truncation
Add Content-Security-Policy header in next.config.mjs or vercel.json
Add BreadcrumbList schema to the 3 utility hub pages currently missing it

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 100% canonical accuracy with zero mismatches or cross-domain issues across all 79 URLs
Clean robots.txt allowing search and AI crawlers with explicit sitemap reference
Solid edge performance on Vercel with 447ms average server TTFB
Real HTTP 404 response on non-existent endpoints (no soft-404 catch-alls)
Full HTTPS enforcement with Strict-Transport-Security (max-age=63072000; preload)

findings.title: 9 Canadian provincial pages orphaned with 0 internal links
findings.description: Pages for Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Newfoundland, PEI, NWT, Nunavut, and Yukon exist in sitemap.xml but have zero internal inlinks.
findings.recommendation: Update /canada to include a full grid of all 13 provinces/territories with descriptive anchor text.

findings.title: Fragment URLs accumulating impressions in Google Search Console
findings.description: URLs with hash fragments (/#calculator, /#faq, /#how-it-works) appear in GSC with over 140 combined impressions.
findings.recommendation: Audit internal navigation links and canonical references to ensure all links use clean path-based URLs without bare hash anchors.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) Header
findings.description: Vercel edge responses include HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, and X-Frame-Options, but no Content-Security-Policy is set.
findings.recommendation: Configure a Content-Security-Policy header in next.config.mjs to protect users against XSS and injection.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: Comprehensive explanation of mathematical reverse sales tax formulas (Formula: Pre-Tax = Total / (1 + Rate))
Fully server-rendered content (8,413 words on homepage) accessible without client-side JS execution
High depth on state pages with local county/city tax nuance tables and exemptions
Clear authoritativeness signals including dedicated Person and Organization review team schemas

findings.title: Boilerplate pattern across state pages risks repetitive content filtering
findings.description: 50 state pages follow identical structural sections. While specific tax rates differ, intro and FAQ paragraphs share template phrasing.
findings.recommendation: Enrich top 15 highest-impression states (NY, CT, TX, UT, CA, NC, FL) with state-specific filing deadlines, nexus thresholds, and local tax nuance tables.

findings.title: High impression query mismatches on specific tax math queries
findings.description: Users search for concrete math examples like 'christa went shopping for back-to-school clothes... if sales tax is 6% what was total' (27 imp, pos 9.4).
findings.recommendation: Add a 'Worked Examples & Word Problems' section to the FAQ addressing common receipt totals ($10, $50, $100, $176) at standard rates.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: 100% single H1 tag coverage across all 79 site pages
Zero duplicate titles or duplicate meta descriptions detected across the entire site
Logical H2 and H3 heading hierarchies mirroring searcher intent
Consistent Open Graph and Twitter Card social metadata implementation

findings.title: 55 Page titles exceed 60 characters (SERP pixel truncation)
findings.description: Titles on state pages average 68-70 characters (e.g. 'Arkansas Sales Tax Calculator 2026: Calculate or Back Out Tax (9.49%)'), causing tax rates to truncate in mobile SERPs.
findings.recommendation: Refactor state title template to: '[State] Reverse Sales Tax Calculator ([Rate]%)' (under 55 characters).

findings.title: 50 Meta descriptions exceed 160 characters
findings.description: Descriptions reach 172-201 characters, resulting in truncated snippets that hide the call to action.
findings.recommendation: Tighten meta descriptions to 145-155 characters, leading with the core utility and instant pre-tax extraction.

findings.title: Low CTR on #1 Impression State Page: /us/new-york (0.05% CTR)
findings.description: /us/new-york ranks at average position 9.1 with 2,133 impressions but only 1 click, indicating snippet mismatch for NYC and county searchers.
findings.recommendation: Update New York meta title to: 'New York Reverse Sales Tax Calculator: 8.875% NYC Included' to match high-volume local search intent.

categories.name: Schema & Structured Data
what_works: Rich @graph implementation on state pages containing WebApplication, HowTo, FAQPage, and BreadcrumbList
Organization and WebSite schemas properly linked with logo and publisher identity
Interactive tool correctly classified as FinanceApplication / WebApplication
HowTo schema includes structured step-by-step instructions for reversing sales tax calculations

findings.title: 3 Utility hub pages missing BreadcrumbList schema
findings.description: While 76 pages have complete BreadcrumbList markup, 3 utility pages (/tax-rates, /about, /contact) lack breadcrumb structured data.
findings.recommendation: Inject consistent BreadcrumbList JSON-LD across all pages for uniform SERP breadcrumb display.

categories.name: Performance & Core Web Vitals
what_works: Average TTFB of 447ms served globally via Vercel Edge Network
Preloaded web fonts (woff2) avoiding layout shifts and FOIT
Responsive image optimization via Next.js next/image with srcset and sizes
Clean responsive viewport with no horizontal scrolling or touch-target failures

findings.title: Multiple small JavaScript chunk requests during Next.js hydration
findings.description: Page loads 8+ script chunks for interactive state. Although TTFB is fast, bundling small chunks reduces HTTP overhead.
findings.recommendation: Ensure Turbopack script optimization combines smaller runtime chunks for faster mobile parsing.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO & Agentic)
what_works: Exceptional llms.txt (3,012 bytes) and llms-full.txt conforming to community standards
Robots.txt explicitly grants permission to GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, and OAI-SearchBot
8,413 words of clean server-rendered content accessible to LLM web scraping agents without JavaScript
Mathematical formulas structured into clean markdown-friendly definition blocks

findings.title: Missing Content-Signal header for AI training preference declaration
findings.description: Optional Cloudflare / IETF Content-Signal header is not declared on robots.txt.
findings.recommendation: Optionally add 'Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no' to establish content usage preferences.

findings.title: Missing WebMCP declarative tool registration
findings.description: The site provides financial calculation utilities but lacks WebMCP registerTool() wrappers for autonomous agent invocation.
findings.recommendation: Implement WebMCP tool registration on the calculator form for agentic browser interactions.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 100% of images possess descriptive, non-empty alt text attributes
Next.js optimized WebP/AVIF generation with responsive srcset attributes
Preloaded formula diagram image above the fold preventing LCP delay

findings.title: Hero diagram image rendered at 3840px max width candidate
findings.description: The formula diagram image srcset includes up to 3840w which is oversized for mobile screens.
findings.recommendation: Cap max srcset generation width to 1600px to save CDN bandwidth.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes & Orphan Elimination
items: Fix Canadian Province Orphans: Add all 9 missing provinces (MB, SK, NS, NB, NL, PE, NT, NU, YT) to the /canada hub navigation grid
Optimize High-Volume State SERP Snippets: Rewrite /us/new-york title and meta description to explicitly highlight 8.875% NYC tax extraction
Trim State Page Titles: Shorten all 55 state titles from ~69 chars to 52-58 chars to eliminate mobile SERP truncation

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact CTR & Content Improvements
items: Target Striking Distance Keywords: Create dedicated on-page sections for 'how to calculate sales tax backwards from total' (Pos 9.7) and 'reverse tax calculator' (Pos 9.2)
Address Math Word Problem Queries: Add worked examples for common dollar figures ($10, $50, $100, $176) to capture featured snippets and AI Overviews
Compress Meta Descriptions: Shorten 50 state page descriptions to 145-155 characters with clear pre-tax calculation call-to-actions

phases.name: Phase 3: Schema & Technical Hardening
items: Deploy Content-Security-Policy (CSP) headers in Vercel configuration
Audit Internal Hash Links: Replace bare #calculator and #faq internal links with canonical path structures
Standardize BreadcrumbList structured data across the remaining 3 utility pages

phases.name: Phase 4: Agentic SEO & Continuous Monitoring
items: Implement WebMCP registerTool() on calculator forms for AI agent accessibility
Track GSC striking distance keyword movements weekly
Monitor Google Search Console Generative AI control and AI citation metrics
